mapper.insert: insert into gf_gacha_history(user_id, permanent_pool_json, character_pool_json, weapon_pool_json, custom_character_pool_json, custom_weapon_pool_json) values (#{userId}, #{permanentPoolJson}, #{characterPoolJson}, #{weaponPoolJson}, #{customCharacterPoolJson}, #{customWeaponPoolJson})
mapper.update: update gf_gacha_history set is_deleted = 1 where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from gf_gacha_history where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
select * from gf_gacha_history where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0 order by created_at desc limit 1
